summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of the British Columbia Steamship Company (1975) Ltd. round logo, built after a supplied circular reference and the 1987 token (see package-README.md and review/comparison.webp). The earlier emblem-only and name-strip reconstructions are kept as downloads.

assets.label: British Columbia Steamship Company (1975) Ltd. — Round logo
assets.notes: A Union Jack over stacked waves inside a ring lettered British Columbia Steamship Company (1975) Ltd. The same emblem and name are on a casino token dated 1987. Its designer, introduction date and colours are unconfirmed.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: clean concentric rings, analytic emblem geometry and outlined Roman serif lettering (six characters redrawn) placed after a supplied circular reference; no automatic tracing. The reference's extra letters after Ltd. are omitted. The original typeface is unidentified, and black and white are neutral.
